nci_valuation.treatment: No separate unmodeled minority-interest claim in this analytical perimeter; alternative claims use the editable additional-claims adjustment.

reported_excerpts.text: Non-marketable equity investments under measurement alternative 20,076 6,018 Non-marketable equity investments under equity method 7,448 52 Total carrying value of non-marketable equity investments $ 27,524 $ 6,070

We do not have the power to direct the activities that most significantly impact the Venture's economic performance. Therefore, we are not the primary beneficiary and do not consolidate the variable interest entity (VIE).
As of December 31, 2025, RVG payments are not probable and therefore, no liability has been recorded.

nonoperating_investments.treatment: Add the 27.524bn total once outside the consolidated EBIT forecast. Equity-method 7.448bn is INCLUDED, not additive; no 34.972bn subtotal. Carrying value is a proxy subject to editable zero/half-value stress, restrictions, liquidity and investee risk.
nonoperating_investments.venture_risk: 20% Louisiana venture includes future funding, leases and contingent RVGs; 45.95bn maximum exposure includes the 1.83bn equity investment and is not a current expected-loss liability. Future operating leases belong in future margins once; the analyst baseline assumes no incremental unmodeled guarantee loss. Additional-claims sensitivity exposes alternative expected incremental loss.

qualification_policy.awards: Anchor common shares plus assumed vesting fraction of unvested RSUs. Full vesting is a conservative dilution proxy, not a current fair-value award calculation; no grant-date value or unrecognized cost deduction. Future SBC remains expensed and potential service-overlap bias is disclosed.
qualification_policy.cash: Gross named unrestricted cash/marketable securities less 2% of anchor revenue as analyst operating-reserve proxy; restricted cash excluded. Additional assets use total nonmarketable investments 27.524bn carrying proxy, including equity-method 7.448bn once; no extra 7.448bn addition.
qualification_policy.debt: Notes disclosed fair value plus finance-lease carrying value as proxy in FCFF bridge. FCFE interest uses carrying debt plus finance leases; debt is not subtracted again after FCFE discounting.
qualification_policy.historical_fcff: Preserve adopted CFO plus expensed-interest allocation less net identified cash PP&E. Capitalized interest is not added again without an investment/tax bridge.
qualification_policy.historical_tax: Retain reported historical provision and CFO, including FY2025 discrete tax effects. Do not add back the accounting charge to CFO; recurring forecast tax is separate.
qualification_policy.investment: Net separately identified PP&E receipts once. Historical cash PP&E differs from forecast cash plus financed additions; no automatic history-to-forecast FCFF CAGR.
qualification_policy.other_claims: Zero additional separate claim is an analyst baseline, not verified absence. Legal/tax accruals remain in modeled operating flows without a second automatic deduction; users can impose incremental unmodeled claims.
qualification_policy.other_financing: Exclude unknown residual by disclosed analyst assumption; allocation stress is not a bound on unidentified offsetting gross flows.

GOOGL.approval: User requested all five outputs analyst-ready for Meta and Alphabet under the approved Apple practical analyst conditions.

assumption_rationales.additional_claims_usd: 0 is no additional adjustment beyond modeled recurring expenses/taxes and separately deducted debt/NCI. It is not proof no contingencies or commitments exist. Pending acquisitions, tax/litigation/guarantee exposure and nonmarketable investments need scenario review, not automatic gross liability deduction.
assumption_rationales.historical_minority_cash_share: Default 0 is an explicitly unallocated consolidated cash-flow proxy, not a filing assertion of zero NCI cash. Display consolidated series and parent-proxy qualification together; show editable 1%/5% illustrative allocation stresses, not bounds. Immaterial reported NCI loss alone cannot establish immaterial NCI cash.
assumption_rationales.lease_investment: Historical financelease financing cash stays in reported debt repayments once; noncash additions are not added to historical cashPPE. Forecast2.5% cashPPE financed additions are an analyst overlay, not historical liability movements; financelease2.5B is included in opening financing debt once, operating leases remain service expense.
assumption_rationales.nci_claim_usd: Use reported total NCI carrying amount as editable valuation proxy where exact subsidiary stakes and full dated market values are not disclosed. Redeemable841M is already inside3.4B, never additive. Deduct once from consolidated operating equity; do not also allocate forward annual FCFE and subtract this claim. Show0/3.4/17/34B stress, not proven fair-value bounds. Do not backdate February2026 Waymo126B postmoney.
assumption_rationales.nonmarketable_investments: 68.687B total non-marketable securities (64.094B measurement-alternative equity plus4.593B equity-method investments and other) are added separately at editable carrying-value proxy, not presented as known fair value. They are financial investments, not PP&E; related gains are in OI&E outside modeled operating EBIT. Use0/50%/100% carrying-value stress, not confidence bounds. These are not consolidated subsidiaries, so do not subtract the consolidated3.4BNCI against them again.
assumption_rationales.operating_cash_reserve_ratio: 2% of annual revenue is a transparent analyst operating-liquidity proxy, not filing-disclosed required cash; expose0%/5% stresses.
assumption_rationales.sbc: Historical CFO includes reported SBC addback; economic cash-flow diagnostic subtracts it. Forecast operating margins retain compensation expense; existing282MRSUs are dilutive at selected vesting fraction and future SBC interpreted as future-grant expense proxy, no extra award fair-value/cost deduction.
assumption_rationales.share_classes: Identical liquidation/dividend rights support equal economic per-share estimates for all A/B/C under the stated assumption; voting/control/liquidity premiums are not valued. Sum all dated classes, not only listedGOOGL or EPS weighted averages.
